   763  theorem uniformIntegrable_const {g : α → β} (hp : 1 ≤ p) (hp_ne_top : p ≠ ∞) (hg : MemLp g p μ) :
   764      UniformIntegrable (fun _ : ι => g) p μ :=
   765    ⟨fun _ => hg.1, unifIntegrable_const hp hp_ne_top hg,
   766      ⟨(eLpNorm g p μ).toNNReal, fun _ => le_of_eq (ENNReal.coe_toNNReal hg.2.ne).symm⟩⟩
   767  
   768  /-- This lemma is superseded by `uniformIntegrable_of` which only requires
   769  `AEStronglyMeasurable`. -/
   770  theorem uniformIntegrable_of' [IsFiniteMeasure μ] (hp : 1 ≤ p) (hp' : p ≠ ∞)
   771      (hf : ∀ i, StronglyMeasurable (f i))
   772      (h : ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ C : ℝ≥0,
   773        ∀ i, eLpNorm ({ x | C ≤ ‖f i x‖₊ }.indicator (f i)) p μ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal ε) :
   774      UniformIntegrable f p μ := by
   775    refine ⟨fun i => (hf i).aestronglyMeasurable,
   776      unifIntegrable_of hp hp' (fun i => (hf i).aestronglyMeasurable) h, ?_⟩
   777    obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := h 1 one_pos
   778    refine ⟨((C : ℝ≥0∞) * μ Set.univ ^ p.toReal⁻¹ + 1).toNNReal, fun i => ?_⟩
   779    calc
   780      eLpNorm (f i) p μ ≤
   781          eLpNorm ({ x : α | ‖f i x‖₊ < C }.indicator (f i)) p μ +
   782            eLpNorm ({ x : α | C ≤ ‖f i x‖₊ }.indicator (f i)) p μ := by
   783        refine le_trans (eLpNorm_mono_enorm fun x => ?_) (eLpNorm_add_le
   784          (StronglyMeasurable.aestronglyMeasurable
   785            ((hf i).indicator ((hf i).nnnorm.measurableSet_lt stronglyMeasurable_const)))
   786          (StronglyMeasurable.aestronglyMeasurable
   787            ((hf i).indicator (stronglyMeasurable_const.measurableSet_le (hf i).nnnorm))) hp)
   788        rw [Pi.add_apply, Set.indicator_apply]
   789        split_ifs with hx
   790        · rw [Set.indicator_of_notMem, add_zero]
   791          simpa using hx
   792        · rw [Set.indicator_of_mem, zero_add]
   793          simpa using hx
   794      _ ≤ (C : ℝ≥0∞) * μ Set.univ ^ p.toReal⁻¹ + 1 := by
   795        have : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, ‖{ x : α | ‖f i x‖₊ < C }.indicator (f i) x‖₊ ≤ C := by
   796          filter_upwards
   797          simp_rw [nnnorm_indicator_eq_indicator_nnnorm]
   798          exact Set.indicator_le fun x (hx : _ < _) => hx.le
   799        refine add_le_add (le_trans (eLpNorm_le_of_ae_bound this) ?_) (ENNReal.ofReal_one ▸ hC i)
   800        simp_rw [NNReal.val_eq_coe, ENNReal.ofReal_coe_nnreal, mul_comm]
   801        exact le_rfl
   802      _ = ((C : ℝ≥0∞) * μ Set.univ ^ p.toReal⁻¹ + 1 : ℝ≥0∞).toNNReal := by
   803        rw [ENNReal.coe_toNNReal (by finiteness)]
   804  
   805  /-- A sequence of functions `(fₙ)` is uniformly integrable in the probability sense if for all
   806  `ε > 0`, there exists some `C` such that `∫ x in {|fₙ| ≥ C}, fₙ x ∂μ ≤ ε` for all `n`. -/
   807  theorem uniformIntegrable_of [IsFiniteMeasure μ] (hp : 1 ≤ p) (hp' : p ≠ ∞)
   808      (hf : ∀ i, AEStronglyMeasurable (f i) μ)
   809      (h : ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ C : ℝ≥0,
   810        ∀ i, eLpNorm ({ x | C ≤ ‖f i x‖₊ }.indicator (f i)) p μ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal ε) :
   811      UniformIntegrable f p μ := by
   812    set g : ι → α → β := fun i => (hf i).choose
   813    have hgmeas : ∀ i, StronglyMeasurable (g i) := fun i => (Exists.choose_spec <| hf i).1
   814    have hgeq : ∀ i, g i =ᵐ[μ] f i := fun i => (Exists.choose_spec <| hf i).2.symm
   815    refine (uniformIntegrable_of' hp hp' hgmeas fun ε hε => ?_).ae_eq hgeq
   816    obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := h ε hε
   817    refine ⟨C, fun i => le_trans (le_of_eq <| eLpNorm_congr_ae ?_) (hC i)⟩
   818    filter_upwards [(Exists.choose_spec <| hf i).2] with x hx
   819    by_cases hfx : x ∈ { x | C ≤ ‖f i x‖₊ }
"}]
